watches.name: Østersøen Mørk
watches.description: The ØSTERSØEN is back, now featuring a mesmerizing Black Mother of Pearl (MOP) dial. The unique iridescence of the MOP captures the essence of the deep Nordic seas, shimmering like the surface of the ocean at dusk. This stunning dial changes in different lighting, reflecting subtle hues and making every glance a new discovery. Crafted from brushed and specially polished stainless steel, the timepieces exude a refined charm, while maintaining a balanced feel on the wrist. Clean and uncluttered, the design embraces simplicity with a no-date feature, paired with elegantly uncomplicated hands and indices. The brushed steel bezel adds a touch of sophistication, perfectly balancing the watch's aesthetics. The ØSTERSØEN Black MOP is for those who appreciate timeless elegance with a twist of natural beauty, offering a connection to the mystic Nordic waters on your wrist. Limited to 50 individually numbered pieces Included in the package: Cork Watch Roll

watches.name: LUNØR Shore Grey
watches.description: With the new LUNØR, Nordic Marine Instruments introduces a new chapter in its collection: a mechanical double moon phase watch inspired by the Nordic night sky, where the moon is not the only illuminating phenomenon on the night sky. Unlike traditional moon phase watches that leave the space between lunar cycles untouched, LUNØR fills the night sky. Between the two moons, a glowing aurora unfolds across the disc, rendered in luminous Super-LumiNova. As the moon fades, the disc transforms, revealing a softly glowing horizon of light that mirrors the northern aurora itself.

specsRaw.Crystal: Flat sapphire crystal with inner Super-AR coating Dial Applied mirror polished indices

This model highlights our clear Nordic design philosophy—understated yet highly functional, with a clean look and sandwich dial. It combines the enchanting beauty of Nordic nights with the rugged explorer style of a field watch. Limited to 50 individually numbered pieces

watches.name: Østersøen Fuldmåne
watches.description: Immerse yourself in the night sky of the Nordic hemisphere with the ØSTERSØEN Fuldmåne . This stunning full lume dial creates the serene brilliance of a clear night, glowing with vintage-inspired BGW9- Super-LumiNova® that reflects the quiet beauty of the northern seas under moonlight. Designed for dreamers and stargazers, it offers a sense of cosmic connection right on the wrist. The watch is crafted from brushed stainless steel with carefully applied MØRK finishing : a deep, black polish that adds an understated elegance and unique visual depth. Its clean, date-free dial preserves the purity of the design, while slim, diamond-cut hands and indices the minimalist clarity of the Nordic landscape. A brushed steel bezel complements the case, adding just the right amount of contrast and elegance. Balanced, timeless, and quietly radiant: the Fuldmåne is made to shine, day or night.
